description: This file defines a report parser class for generating account balance reports in an OpenERP (Odoo) module, including methods for retrieving fiscal year and period information, and processing account hierarchy for report lines.

classes.name: account_balance
classes.description: Report parser class for account balance report, extending report_sxw.rml_parse.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the report parser, setting up local context and internal variables.

methods.name: get_fiscalyear
methods.description: Retrieves the name of the fiscal year given its ID from the form data.

methods.name: get_periods
methods.description: Retrieves a formatted string of period names based on form data or fiscal year object.

methods.name: lines
methods.description: Generates hierarchical account line data for the report, processing child accounts recursively.

methods.name: _sum_credit
methods.description: Returns the total credit sum accumulated.

methods.name: _sum_debit
methods.description: Returns the total debit sum accumulated.
